thread:
tim-release: Heads-up: starting schema change v3.7.1 at 23:00 UTC on prod-shard-2. This is an ALTER + conditional backfill. Will canary first and watch locks.

jules-dba: Plan: canary on shard-2 -> monitor locks for 5m -> expand to 3 shards -> full. Backfill done in 5k batches with a short sleep between batches.

sara-eng: ETA for canary start?

deploy-bot: deploybot: kicking off job release:redwood-schema-v3.7.1 -> runner:db-migration on prod-shard-2

tim-release: starting now. please watch pg_stat_activity and lock queue lengths.

marco-infra: I deployed a lightweight scraper to /ops/alerts to surface exclusive lock waiters >30s. Threshold set to 3 waiting conns.

jules-dba: Migration steps: 1) ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN policy JSONB DEFAULT '{}' (fast path via IF NOT EXISTS) 2) backfill via UPDATE in batches. If backfill hits persistent pk locks, we fallback to create column without backfill and schedule offline job.

sara-eng: If ETA for backfill increases >50% compared to baseline, we should pause and switch to fallback. Agree?

ops-oncall: @channel If we see >5 waiting lockers for >60s, call the rollback hatch: pause rollout and, if necessary, run psql -c 'ALTER TABLE tenant_shards DROP COLUMN policy;' on the canary shard to revert. Document incident.

tim-release: During canary we hit a spike: 12 waiters for ~90s. I paused the rollout. Do not promote.

deploy-bot: deploybot: paused rollout release:redwood-schema-v3.7.1 by user:tim-release

jules-dba: Digging into locks: found a long-running prepared statement holding a scan on tenant_events. Killing that session freed up locks.

sara-eng: Root cause: why was a long TX open? Any pinned versions causing sticky workers?

marco-infra: Found a stale background worker job pinned to worker:v2.4 with an old PG driver behavior — it kept a transaction open across retries. I queued a kill on the PID.

jules-dba: After kill, contention dropped to zero. Backfill resumed but slower. Recommend switching to fallback: create column without backfill, add nightly throttled backfill job.

tim-release: Agreed. Update release notes: final rollout will create column only (no immediate backfill). Backfill scheduled nightly with rate limit. Root cause: pinned worker v2.4 holding long TX.

sara-eng: Please add rollback runbook snippet in release notes: how to detect blocking tx, how to drop column if necessary, and how to unpin worker versions across environments.

tim-release: Will do. Also add a CI check to detect pinned old drivers in artifacts.

ops-oncall: I'll update alerts: auto-pause on migration when >5 waiting locks for >60s and open an incident for review.

jules-dba: Suggestion for future migrations: wrap heavy UPDATE batches with SET LOCAL lock_timeout = 5000; and use smaller batch sizes for tenant-heavy tables. Also prefer adding nullable column + async backfill.

sara-eng: +1. Also add a note to the deploy checklist to verify no pinned background workers exist on target shards before running schema migrations.

tim-release: Thanks everyone. Rollout remains paused until release notes + backfill plan merged and pinned jobs cleared. Re-run canary after infra confirms pinned workers removed.
